about: Banks, hotels, diplomatic bodies, hospitals and construction companies can apply to reserve parking spaces.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. TAMM fills the form in after UAE PASS sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Banks, hotels, political and diplomatic bodies, hospitals and construction companies for projects
fees: AED 15,000 per parking space per 6 months (private)
AED 85 per parking space per day (private)
channels: TAMM website or app (sign in with UAE PASS)
